description: Base Theme Capability Registry v2.2 — LLM reads this to discover all available capabilities

capabilities.name: seo
capabilities.summary: SEO meta tags: Open Graph, Schema.org

capabilities.name: google_analytics
capabilities.summary: Google Analytics GA4 tracking

capabilities.name: mdf-brand
capabilities.summary: MDFriday brand badge (fixed position)

capabilities.name: encrypt
capabilities.summary: AES-GCM content encryption with password modal

capabilities.name: toc
capabilities.summary: Table of Contents — 3 variants: static (front-matter toc:true), sticky (slot-toc block), interactive (sticky+IntersectionObserver). Config: params.toc.variant

capabilities.name: post-card
capabilities.summary: Article card component for list pages

capabilities.name: pagination
capabilities.summary: Pagination — 2 variants: simple (prev/count/next), numbered (page buttons). Config: params.pagination.variant

capabilities.name: comments
capabilities.summary: Comment system router (Disqus / Utterances)

capabilities.name: disqus
capabilities.summary: Disqus comment system

capabilities.name: katex
capabilities.summary: Math formulas via KaTeX — Foundry built-in, always-on global load (head/math.html + katex-render.js); shortcode outputs data-math marker only

capabilities.name: mermaid
capabilities.summary: Diagrams via Mermaid — classic mermaid-render.js + dynamic import() of Mermaid 10 ESM from jsDelivr; shortcode outputs pre.mermaid marker only

capabilities.name: youtube
capabilities.summary: Embed YouTube videos

capabilities.name: bilibili
capabilities.summary: Embed Bilibili videos

capabilities.name: vimeo
capabilities.summary: Embed Vimeo videos

capabilities.name: utterances
capabilities.summary: GitHub Issues-based comment system

capabilities.name: x
capabilities.summary: Embed X (Twitter) posts

capabilities.name: instagram
capabilities.summary: Embed Instagram posts

capabilities.name: darkmode
capabilities.summary: Dark/light mode with data-theme standard on <html>; FOUC prevention in theme-init.html; sub-theme only needs CSS [data-theme='dark'] variables

capabilities.name: search
capabilities.summary: FlexSearch unified search modal; enable: params.search.enable=true; trigger placement: params.search.trigger=header|sidebar|none; CJK: params.search.cjk=true; data: window.__MDF_SEARCH__ injected by search-data.html

capabilities.name: clipboard
capabilities.summary: Code block copy button — adds copy btn to all <pre><code> blocks; enable: params.clipboard=true; CSS: --mdf-clipboard-* variables

capabilities.name: explorer
capabilities.summary: File-tree sidebar navigation; enable: params.explorer=true (requires search.enable=true); CSS: --mdf-explorer-* variables

capabilities.name: graph
capabilities.summary: Knowledge graph D3+PixiJS; enable: params.graph=true (requires search.content=true); CSS: --mdf-graph-* variables. Wiki themes only.

capabilities.name: callout
capabilities.summary: Rich callout/alert block: type=note|info|warning|error|tip|success + optional title + optional fold (collapsible)

capabilities.name: tabs
capabilities.summary: CSS-only tab panels (no JavaScript); use with tab shortcode; sub-theme overrides static/caps/tabs/tabs.css

capabilities.name: details
capabilities.summary: Collapsible details/summary block with optional open param; uses browser-native <details> element

capabilities.name: columns
capabilities.summary: Multi-column layout with optional ratio support (ratio='1:2'); delimiter: ===

capabilities.name: gallery
capabilities.summary: PhotoSwipe v5 lightbox gallery; assets lazy-loaded per-page via Scratch

capabilities.name: breadcrumbs
capabilities.summary: Breadcrumb navigation (baseURL-aware v2.2); enable globally: params.breadcrumbs=true; disable per-page: breadcrumbs: false in front-matter

capabilities.name: readermode
capabilities.summary: Reader mode toggle: hides sidebars by toggling body.mdf-reader-mode; enable: params.readerMode=true in config
